answer: Sybil resistance can work through stake-bonded identity: each agent locks a kernel of collateral before earning trust, and reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations. Forging many identities then costs real capital per node, while honest actors recover their bond on exit. To prevent cheap identity churn, a crystal of provenance records each agent's origin and attestation history, so a fresh plume of accounts with no verifiable past is discounted by peers. Attackers must fund every fake identity and sustain it through audits, making mass sybil creation economically irrational...
